name: vault
description: Agent-native secret and credential manager for HEROS. Store, retrieve, list, and delete named secrets with base64-encoded values, flock-protected writes, rate limiting, HMAC auth, and a human-approval gate on deletion.

invocation.bridge_note: Pure bash implementation — no separate binary. All persistence (one JSON file per secret, JSONL index, JSONL audit log) is owned by this bridge. flock prevents concurrent write corruption.

signing.manifest_sha256: UNSIGNED in source — cosign sign-blob runs in CI at publish time

tools.name: vault_secret_set
tools.title: Store Secret
tools.description: Create or update a named secret. Value is any UTF-8 text string (binary payloads with NUL bytes are unsupported — base64-encode them yourself first). Idempotent by name — same name overwrites. Returns secret_id, version, timestamps. Secret names: [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], max 128 chars, no path traversal. Values stored base64-encoded on disk. Requires rw scope when auth is enabled.

name.description: UNTRUSTED. Secret name. Pattern: [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], max 128 chars. No path traversal (no .. or /).

value.description: UNTRUSTED. Secret value. Arbitrary string up to 64 KiB. Stored base64-encoded.

description.description: UNTRUSTED. Optional human-readable description. ASCII printable only, max 512 chars.

INVALID_INPUT.fix: Check name charset/length and description charset/length

STORE_READ_FAILED.fix: I/O error reading existing secret; check disk and permissions

STORE_WRITE_FAILED.fix: I/O error writing secret; check disk space and permissions

INVALID_API_KEY.fix: Obtain a valid key via ledger key create

API_KEY_REVOKED.fix: Rotate key via ledger key rotate

tools.name: vault_secret_get
tools.title: Retrieve Secret
tools.description: Retrieve a named secret's value and metadata. Returns secret_id, name, value (decoded), description, created_at, version. Access is logged to .vault-audit (ts/op/name only — value never logged). Requires ro scope when auth is enabled.

name.description: UNTRUSTED. Name of the secret to retrieve. Pattern: [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], max 128 chars.

SECRET_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check name spelling; secret may not exist yet

STORE_READ_FAILED.fix: I/O error or corrupt secret file

tools.name: vault_secret_delete
tools.title: Delete Secret
tools.description: Delete a named secret. Irreversible — requires human sign-off via approval_nonce flow. First call (no token) returns decision_required with approval_nonce. Second call with human_acknowledgment_token (5-min TTL, single-use) executes deletion. Requires rw scope when auth is enabled.

name.description: UNTRUSTED. Name of the secret to delete. Pattern: [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], max 128 chars.

human_acknowledgment_token.description: Nonce from a prior approval_nonce response. Pass after human approves deletion. Single-use, 5-min TTL.

STORE_WRITE_FAILED.fix: I/O error; check disk and permissions

INVALID_ACKNOWLEDGMENT_TOKEN.fix: Re-run vault_secret_delete without token to get a fresh approval_nonce

tools.name: vault_secret_list
tools.title: List Secrets
tools.description: List all secret names and metadata. Returns name, description, created_at, version for each secret. Secret values are NEVER included in list output. Count is total number of stored secrets. Use vault_secret_get to retrieve a specific value.

STORE_READ_FAILED.fix: Failed to read vault index; check permissions

rate_limit_spec.state: in-memory bridge process (resets on bridge restart)

security.storage_model: one JSON file per secret in .vault-secrets/, JSONL index in .vault-index, JSONL audit in .vault-audit
security.value_encoding: base64 on disk — raw bytes never written as-is
security.audit: .vault-audit logs ts/op/name on every get and delete — value never logged
security.delete_gate: decision_required approval_nonce flow — single-use 5-min TTL token required
security.content_policy: Tool descriptions audited against mcp-security-spec.md §4.3. No instruction-format language. <= 512 chars.

agent_quickstart: 1. Call vault_secret_set to store a credential: {name, value, description}.
2. Call vault_secret_get to retrieve a value by name.
3. Call vault_secret_list to enumerate stored secrets (names only, no values).
4. To delete: call vault_secret_delete without token — get approval_nonce — present to human.
5. After human approves, call vault_secret_delete again with human_acknowledgment_token.
6. Deletion is irreversible. When in doubt, list first to confirm the name before deleting.
